##### Project general facts

Granada is a premium low-rise residential development within the fully integrated Bloom Living community in Abu Dhabi, designed to bring a new standard of community-focused living. Inspired by the charm of traditional Mediterranean architecture, the project combines warm, timeless aesthetics with modern functionality. It offers a collection of studios, as well as one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, all featuring spacious layouts, generous balconies, and an emphasis on natural light, creating bright and comfortable living spaces with a strong sense of openness.

Residents of Granada benefit from a wide range of lifestyle amenities within the Bloom Living community, all within walking distance. The development is surrounded by interconnected parks and landscaped green spaces, creating a serene and pedestrian-friendly environment. A central clubhouse provides access to swimming pools, sports facilities, and recreational areas, supporting an active and social lifestyle while maintaining a relaxed, community-oriented atmosphere.

Interiors are finished with modern and elegant materials, complemented by open-plan layouts, high ceilings, and large windows that enhance light and space throughout each apartment. Kitchens are equipped, ensuring practicality and convenience for everyday living. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their interiors while enjoying high-quality finishes and well-designed living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

An all-inclusive, fully integrated community where true happiness lies in a balanced lifestyle. Where deep connections thrive and natural beauty comes alive. Bloom Living is an ideal community for those seeking a peaceful life. An all-inclusive community, where you can enjoy an active lifestyle while supporting the environment through social activities or simply riding your bike to school.  

At Bloom living exclusivity comes alive with dedicated community centers, designed to serve each residential cluster. The community center is a daily invitation for residents to connect in breathtaking settings while enjoying an unrivaled host of amenities spanning pools, recreational zones and a safe play area for kids.  

Enjoy a signature selection of artisanal cafés and world-class restaurants inspiring every taste. All you need to do, is head out to the Town Centre on foot to discover limitless retail and F&B possibilities, without having to leave Bloom Living. The multi-generational community is an exclusive invitation to connect with family and loved ones in a unique settings, fostering timeless experiences and moments.
